# Tool catalog

88 tools as registered in `osint_mcp/app.py`. Regenerate with:

```bash
python scripts/gen_catalog.py
```


## Private, persistent investigation graph

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `case_create` | Create or reopen a local investigation case. Data stays in a private SQLite file |
| `case_list` | List locally saved investigation cases with entity, source and fact counts |
| `case_add_fact` | Add an explicit relationship to a case, with a source and short evidence quote |
| `case_note` | Save a person, place, event, organization, or other entity with a short note |
| `case_capture` | Save source URLs and entity mentions from a browser_crawl/deep_osint JSON result |
| `case_research` | Run deep_osint, then automatically save discovered sources and entity mentions |
| `case_search` | Search a case's entities, sources, observations, and relationship text |
| `case_graph` | Return case entities and evidenced edges; optionally focus on one entity |
| `case_export` | Export a full case as portable JSON (entities, sources, observations, facts, image metadata) |
| `case_image_add` | Save a local/remote image in a case, analyze it, and optionally file it under a person |
| `case_image_similar` | Find visually similar images already saved in this case using dHash distance |
| `case_image_view` | Return a saved image inline so a vision-capable MCP client can inspect it |
| `case_image_crop` | Crop a region for closer visual inspection and save it as a new case image |
| `case_image_reverse` | Find pages using an image through TinEye API, plus manual search links |
| `person_dossier` | Build a private per-person profile.json with notes, facts, images and sources |

## Composite overview

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `recon_domain` | One-shot domain recon: DNS, RDAP whois, TLS cert, crt.sh subdomains, headers, tech, robots |
| `recon_ip` | One-shot IP recon: geo/ASN, Shodan InternetDB, PTR, reverse-IP domains, top-20 ports |
| `recon_deep` | Deep passive recon: subdomains + archives + API surface + email + threat intel |

## DNS / infrastructure

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `dns_lookup` | Resolve DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV or ANY) |
| `dnssec_status` | Inspect DNSSEC DS and DNSKEY publication for a domain |
| `dns_resolver_compare` | Compare public DNS answers from Cloudflare and Google over DNS-over-HTTPS |
| `reverse_dns` | PTR lookup for an IPv4/IPv6 address (returns hostnames pointing back at the IP) |
| `crtsh_subdomains` | Enumerate subdomains from certificate transparency logs (crt.sh), passive |
| `subdomain_enum` | Brute-force subdomains of a domain using a built-in wordlist (or a custom one) |
| `dns_zone_transfer` | Attempt an AXFR zone transfer against every authoritative nameserver |

## Domain / TLS / historical web

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `domain_whois` | Registration data for a domain via RDAP (the modern WHOIS replacement) |
| `ssl_certificate` | Inspect the live TLS certificate of a host: subject, issuer, SANs, validity |
| `robots_txt` | Fetch and parse robots.txt: user-agent groups, disallow/allow rules, sitemaps |
| `security_txt` | Look for RFC 9116 security.txt at /.well-known/ and root, parse its fields |
| `sitemap_urls` | Discover and parse sitemap.xml (including sitemap indexes) to list URLs |
| `wayback_urls` | List archived URLs from the Wayback Machine CDX API (historical endpoints/files) |

## IP

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `ip_intel` | Full IP profile: geolocation/ASN/org + Shodan InternetDB open ports, hostnames, CVEs |
| `asn_lookup` | Look up an ASN (e.g. AS15169), an IP, or a domain: holder, country, announced prefixes |
| `reverse_ip` | Reverse-IP lookup: other domains hosted on the same IP (Hackertarget, keyless) |
| `port_scan` | TCP connect scan. Presets: top20, top100, web, db, common - or "80,443,8000-8100" |

## Web recon

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `http_fetch` | Fetch a URL with custom method/headers/body and return status, headers and body |
| `http_headers_audit` | Audit HTTP security headers and cookie flags; returns a score (0-100) and grade |
| `tech_fingerprint` | Fingerprint the web stack from headers, cookies and HTML patterns |
| `extract_links` | Extract and categorize links from a page: internal, external, emails, scripts, forms |
| `page_metadata` | Extract page metadata: title, meta/OG/Twitter tags, headings, forms, scripts, IDs |

## Search

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `web_search` | Search the web (keyless) with automatic engine fallback |
| `google_dorks` | Generate ready-to-click Google/Bing/DDG dork URLs for a domain or brand |
| `github_search` | Search GitHub repositories, users, issues or (authenticated) code |

## Identity

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `username_search` | Check whether a username exists on ~25 platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Reddit, Telegram...) |
| `email_intel` | Profile an email: syntax, MX/SPF/DMARC, disposable check, Gravatar, breaches |

## Breach / leaked-data exposure (metadata only; personal lookups need authorized=True)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `breach_check` | Check one email, domain or username for breach exposure across several providers |
| `breach_catalog` | Search the public Have I Been Pwned breach catalogue by company, domain or keyword |
| `stealer_log_check` | Focused infostealer check for one email or username |
| `domain_breach_exposure` | Assess a whole domain's breach exposure without returning employee emails |
| `breach_providers` | Show which breach/leaked-data providers are available, without exposing keys |

## Threat intelligence (OTX / VirusTotal keys optional)

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `otx_domain` | AlienVault OTX threat profile for a domain: pulses, malware, hosted URLs, validation |
| `virustotal_report` | VirusTotal v3 report for an IP, domain, URL or file hash |
| `cve_intel` | CVE intelligence: description, CVSS, CWE, EPSS score and CISA KEV status |
| `threat_reputation` | One-shot reputation verdict for an IP, domain, URL or file hash |
| `dnsbl_check` | Check an IP (or domain) against major DNS blocklists via direct DNS queries |
| `tor_exit_check` | Check whether an IP (or a domain's IPs) is a Tor exit node |
| `greynoise_ip` | GreyNoise community lookup: is this IP mass-scanning the internet (noise/RIOT)? |
| `ip_whois` | RDAP registration data for an IP: network range, holder, ASN, contacts, events |
| `urlhaus_lookup` | Look up a host/domain/URL in abuse.ch URLhaus (requires URLHAUS_AUTH_KEY) |
| `peeringdb_network` | PeeringDB network profile by ASN (AS15169) or name: policy, IX and facility presence |
| `openphish_check` | Check a URL or domain against the OpenPhish public phishing feed (keyless) |

## Discovery / deep search

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `urlscan_search` | Search urlscan.io scans for a domain, IP, URL or filename (keyless) |
| `commoncrawl_urls` | Find archived URLs for a domain in the Common Crawl index (keyless) |
| `passive_subdomains` | Aggregate passive subdomains from crt.sh, HackerTarget, RapidDNS and OTX |
| `js_recon` | Extract API endpoints, URLs, source maps and potential secrets from a page's JavaScript |
| `api_discovery` | Probe common API/spec/debug paths on a domain (light, non-intrusive) |
| `well_known` | Fetch standard /.well-known documents and summarize OIDC, JWKS, security.txt and app links |
| `subdomain_takeover_check` | Check subdomains for dangling CNAMEs to known takeover-prone providers |
| `favicon_hash` | Fetch a site's favicon and compute the Shodan mmh3 hash (plus MD5/SHA256) |
| `cloud_bucket_check` | Check whether an S3/GCS/Azure bucket exists and allows public object listing |

## Social / code search

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `hackernews_search` | Search Hacker News stories/comments via the keyless Algolia API |
| `grep_app_search` | Search public code on grep.app (keyless; browser fallback for bot checks) |
| `bluesky_profile` | Look up a public Bluesky profile and recent posts (keyless AT Protocol API) |
| `npm_search` | Search the public npm registry for packages (keyless) |

## Email security

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `email_security` | Audit a domain's email security: SPF, DMARC, DKIM, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and CAA |

## Browser

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `browser_open` | Open a URL in a real headless Chrome tab, wait for JS, and report what is there |
| `browser_extract` | Render a page in Chrome and extract text + links (optionally a CSS selector only) |
| `browser_screenshot` | Open a URL in Chrome and return an actual screenshot image (PNG) |
| `browser_eval` | Run a JavaScript expression inside a rendered page and return the JSON result |

## Browser-driven deep OSINT / image analysis

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `deep_osint` | Full browser-driven OSINT run: search, crawl sources, cross-check, image analysis |
| `browser_search` | Search the web in a real Chromium browser and return result links |
| `browser_crawl` | Open a real browser, analyze a page, then follow relevant links |
| `source_crosscheck` | Fetch several source URLs and cross-check entities across them |
| `image_analyze` | Analyze an image from a URL or local path |

## Utilities

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `jwt_decode` | Decode a JWT header and payload without verifying the signature |
| `hash_text` | Hash a string with one or more algorithms (md5, sha1, sha256, sha512, sha3_256...) |
| `image_exif` | Extract EXIF metadata (camera, timestamps, GPS) from a local image or image URL |
| `doctor` | Self-diagnostic: python deps, API keys, browser, database, and guard state |
